experiment.title: SCE 1.8 Detective Probe: Validate Detection of IMDS Enumeration and Downgrade Attacks
experiment.description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment that validates detective controls detect attack steps 1.2 (ec2:DescribeInstances for IMDS enumeration - T1580) and 1.7 (ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to downgrade IMDSv2 to IMDSv1 and increase hop limit - T1562.001). The experiment provisions a banking-tier EC2 instance, CloudTrail trail, EventBridge rule with SNS-to-SQS notification pipeline, and AWS Config managed rule ec2-imdsv2-check. Both attack steps are executed successfully via an attacker IAM role, then the experiment verifies within a 30-minute SLA that: (1) CloudTrail recorded both API calls, (2) EventBridge fired a notification for ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions that arrived in SQS, and (3) AWS Config evaluates the modified instance as NON_COMPLIANT.
